compile.simps(4).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (Seq c1.0 c2.0) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) =
       compile \<Pi> p c1.0 (Statement (n + csize c1.0)) n;
     (n2, en2, E2, K2) = compile \<Pi> p c2.0 k (n + csize c1.0)
 in (n2, en1, E1 \<union> E2, K1 \<union> K2))
compile.simps(4).why: Program-model chapter: compiling a sequence hands the first command the second's entry.

compile.simps(5).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (com.If b c1.0 c2.0) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) = compile \<Pi> p c1.0 k (Suc n);
     (n2, en2, E2, K2) = compile \<Pi> p c2.0 k n1
 in (n2, Statement n,
     {(Statement n, EA_Assume b, if c1.0 = SKIP then k else en1),
      (Statement n, EA_AssumeNot b,
       if c2.0 = SKIP then k else en2)} \<union>
     (if c1.0 = SKIP then {} else E1) \<union>
     (if c2.0 = SKIP then {} else E2),
     K1 \<union> K2))
compile.simps(5).why: Program-model chapter: both branches of a conditional compile against one continuation.

compile.simps(6).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (While b c) k n =
(let (n1, en1, E1, K1) = compile \<Pi> p c (Statement n) (Suc n)
 in (n1, Statement n,
     {(Statement n, EA_Assume b, en1),
      (Statement n, EA_AssumeNot b, k)} \<union>
     E1,
     K1))
compile.simps(6).why: Program-model chapter: a loop body compiles against the loop head.

compile.simps(8).statement:
compile \<Pi> p (Return e) k n =
(Suc n, Statement n, {(Statement n, EA_Ret e p, FunctionResult p)}, {})
compile.simps(8).why: Program-model chapter: a return edge targets the procedure's result node.

csim_star.statement:
\<lbrakk>\<Pi>,g \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<approx> (v, t, stk);
 procs_embedded \<Pi> g; return_safe c;
 \<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile> (c, s, frs) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 src'\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>cfg'.
                     \<G>,g \<turnstile>
                     (v, t, stk) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>c\<^sup>* cfg' \<and>
                     \<Pi>,g \<turnstile> src' \<approx> cfg'
csim_star.why: Main-statements appendix: simulation of source runs by the compiled graph.

csim_step.statement:

\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>cfg'.
                     \<G>,g \<turnstile>
                     (v, t, stk) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>c\<^sup>* cfg' \<and>

nv_source_certified.statement:
\<exists>res v stk.
   run_voblint Interval_Analysis Globals_Warrow Ctx_EntryState nv_prog =
   Analysed res \<and>
   map (\<lambda>chk. (check_point chk, check_verdict chk))
    (res_checks res) =
   [(Statement 4, Decided Check_Proved),
    (Statement 5, Decided Check_Proved)] \<and>
   prog_table nv_prog,prog_cfg nv_prog \<turnstile>
   (Seq (Check (0, 0) (exp.Eq (V STR ''a'') (N 6)))
     (Check (0, 0) (exp.Eq (V STR ''b'') (N 5))),
    nv_final, []) \<approx>
   (v, nv_final, stk) \<and>
   nv_final
   \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
                      nv_prog,prog_cfg
                               nv_prog,cinit_stores
  (declared_global nv_prog)\<^esub>
          v \<and>
   analysis_result_covers Interval_Analysis Globals_Warrow Ctx_EntryState
    nv_prog v nv_final \<and>
   checks_sound_at res v nv_final
nv_source_certified.why: Non-vacuity section of the evaluation: the endpoint's premises hold for one program.

run_voblint_certified_source_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>s0.0 \<in> cinit_stores (declared_global p);
 declared_global p,prog_table p \<turnstile>
 (main_body (prog_table p), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs);
 config_terminates D rule ctx p;
 run_voblint D rule ctx p = Analysed res\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk.
                     prog_table p,prog_cfg p \<turnstile>
                     (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk) \<and>
                     s \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
    p,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                              v \<and>
                     analysis_result_covers D rule ctx p v s \<and>
                     checks_sound_at res v s
run_voblint_certified_source_sound.why: The introduction states the source-level soundness result with its actual premises.

run_voblint_check_sound.statement:
\<lbrakk>s0.0 \<in> cinit_stores (declared_global p);
 declared_global p,prog_table p \<turnstile>
 (main_body (prog_table p), s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs);
 next_check residual = Some (l, e); config_terminates D rule ctx p;
 run_voblint D rule ctx p = Analysed res\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>c\<in>set (res_checks res).
                     check_label c = l \<and>
                     check_exp c = e \<and>
                     s \<in> \<C>\<^bsub>declared_global
    p,prog_cfg p,cinit_stores (declared_global p)\<^esub>
                              (check_point c) \<and>
                     check_verdict c \<noteq> Dead \<and>
                     (check_verdict c =
                      Decided Check_Proved \<longrightarrow>
                      truthy (\<lbrakk>e\<rbrakk>\<^sub>e s)) \<and>
                     (check_verdict c =
                      Decided Check_Refuted \<longrightarrow>
                      \<not> truthy (\<lbrakk>e\<rbrakk>\<^sub>e s))
run_voblint_check_sound.why: Check-verdict endpoint cited in the introduction.

run_voblint_dead_check_unreached.why: Unreachability endpoint cited in the introduction.

source_run_has_ltr.statement:
\<lbrakk>wf_compile_input \<G> \<Pi> ps; s0.0 \<in> S;
 \<G>,\<Pi> \<turnstile>
 (main_body \<Pi>, s0.0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>*
 (residual, s, frs)\<rbrakk>
\<Longrightarrow> \<exists>v stk t.
                     \<Pi>,compile_prog \<Pi> ps \<turnstile>
                     (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk) \<and>
                     ltr_repr \<G> (compile_prog \<Pi> ps) S (v, s, stk) t
